name: registration-and-startup-confirmation
changes: Added Core module registration records, store, digest provider, registration clock, in-memory store, SHA-256 manifest digest provider, and registration service.
Added deterministic canonical manifest JSON with sorted object keys, preserved array order, explicit null/default fields, and lowercase SHA-256 digest output.
Integrated registration confirmation into ModuleManager discovery.
Added activation-time checks for missing, unconfirmed, and stale registration records.
Exposed registered metadata through ModuleManager without creating module instances.
Added Windows platform Registry registration store and CNG SHA-256 digest provider adapters.
Added registration unit tests and runtime registration tests.
testsAdded: Register and confirm manifest state transition.
Boot registers discovered metadata without instantiating modules.
Activation fails when registration is missing.
Activation fails when registration is unconfirmed.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files

knownLimitations: Native compile and test execution still require Windows/MSVC, CMake, CTest, vcpkg, and PowerShell.
Data isolation wrappers, default-role orchestration, and UI contribution contract ownership continue in later phases.
